title: Jagged Buttery Russian Gruyere Toast
description: A buttery, gooey, lazy-Sunday Russian dish featuring Gruyere, toast, and a low-calorie friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter one side of each bread slice with 1/2 tablespoon of unsalted butter.
Place the bread slices buttered side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Top each bread slice with a slice of Gruyere cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg and season with salt and black pepper.
Brush the egg mixture over the Gruyere cheese.
Bake the toast in the preheated oven for 10 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove the toast from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Serve the Jagged Buttery Russian Gruyere Toast warm and enjoy.
